projects.title: `Pawpal - Pet care with AI
projects.description: • Developed an AI-powered pet health monitoring app at GeeseHacks 2025, integrating AI-driven insights for disease identification and personalized treatment recommendations.• Designed a secure, scalable backend using Firebase and Google Auth, paired with a user-friendly React.js interface, supporting features like customized diet plans, proactive health alerts, and vaccination/feeding reminders.• Prepared a detailed business model and conducted market research, developing a marketing strategy targeting 20% of the Canadian pet-owning population.

projects.title: Biquadris - Multiplayer Tetris
projects.description: • Developed a double-player Tetris purely by designing UML and utilizing C++ object-oriented programming resulting in a 2-player game with a graphical XWindows and a text-based interface.• Designed the game using 3 design patterns- Decorator, Observer, and Factory method, highlighting the MVC structure, allowing user to play in 4 levels of increasing difficulty.• Built a smart bot that plays the game with user using Minimax algorithm, allowing user to play in 3 different ways.

projects.title: Hestia Housing
projects.description: • Developed an innovative platform designed to streamline the process for university students to sublet or find sublets, enhancing housing accessibility and convenience. • Implemented advanced features and user-centric design principles on the website, enabling intuitive navigation, real-time updates, and personalized housing recommendations for an enhanced user experience.

projects.title: GUI Calculator
projects.description: Engineered an advanced GUI calculator using Python, the PyQt library, and the sys library, featuring an intuitive user interface and supporting both basic arithmetic operations and advanced functions like square root calculations.

projects.title: RPG Battle Script
projects.description: • Engineered advanced RPG Combat system in Python using object-oriented programming, defining player and enemy attributes, spells, and items for an immersive experience. • Developed a dynamic system, allowing the strategic management of HP and MP through command line with customizable spells and items. • Implemented a robust spell management system with complex functionalities and random elements for responsive combat scenarios.

projects.title: Arduino-based Voice-controlled multi-task robot, Line following and obstacle-avoiding car, Vending machine, etc
Automatic Irrigational Machine
projects.description: • Founded a startup to aid farmers through the creation of an Arduino-based machine for measuring soil moisture and dispensing water according to crop-specific moisture needs. • Managed all financial aspects and formulated a business model for the venture. Successfully presented the concept to investors in a competition, earning the runner-up position.

projects.title: Game engine of DouDizhu
projects.description: • Created a Doudizhu game engine and player bots in Racket for enhanced gameplay. • Developed algorithms for decision-making and conducted simulations to determine game outcomes and winners, showcasing proficiency in game development and algorithmic design.
